## Presentation

> The teachers Artur Cortés and Lluís Terrado direct this part of the module of development, learning and education called **management of the learning environment in the classroom**, where the management of the learning environment in the classroom is addressed through the four great areas on which it can be incidence to build a good learning environment: bonding, routines, boundaries, and motivation.
